1–2 hours (depends on your luck with the rare orc)

{npc:Sam}, the blacksmith of Thais, lost his old adventurer's backpack in an orc attack at Ulderek's Rock. Find it on a rare orc in the Orc Fortress, return it to Sam and he sends you to his friend {npc:Kroox}, in Kazordoon, who lets you fetch a {item:Dwarven Armor} from the dwarven mines.
